CVE-2020-8169.title: curl: partial password leak over DNS on HTTP redirect
CVE-2020-8169.description: curl 7.62.0 through 7.70.0 is vulnerable to an information disclosure vulnerability.

CVE-2023-38039.title: curl: out of heap memory issue due to missing limit on header quantity
CVE-2023-38039.description: When curl retrieves an HTTP response, it stores the incoming headers so that they can be accessed later via the libcurl headers API.
